recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以大型細胞為主，核圓或卵圓、部分有摺痕或凹陷，染色質細緻呈網狀、可見核仁，細胞質豐富呈灰藍色、邊緣有偽足狀突起，這是單核母細胞/前單核細胞的特徵，符合急性單核球性白血病。
features: Large blasts with moderate to abundant cytoplasm (lower N:C ratio than lymphoblasts)
Round to oval nuclei, some indented or folded (promonocyte-like)
Finely reticular, lacy chromatin with one or more nucleoli
Grey-blue cytoplasm with cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopod-like projections and occasional vacuoles
Granules sparse; no Auer rods identified
Few residual maturing cells in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is largely replaced by large blasts with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, round to oval or indented nuclei, finely reticular chromatin and visible nucleoli. The cytoplasm shows irregular blebs and pseudopod-like projections with occasional vacuoles, and granules are sparse without Auer rods. Residual normal hematopoiesis is minimal. Findings are consistent with acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia; confirmation by nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11b, CD4, lysozyme) is recommended, along with testing for KMT2A rearrangement.

ddx.vs: AMML contains at least 20% neutrophil-lineage cells and MPO-positive myeloblasts in addition to monocytic cells, whereas this field is dominated by monoblasts/promonocytes.
Often monocytic with cup-like nuclei; separated by NPM1 mutation testing and cytoplasmic NPM1 immunostaining rather than morphology alone.
BPDCN cells have agranular cytoplasm with small peripheral vacuoles and are CD4/CD56/CD123/TCF4-positive but NSE- and lysozyme-negative.

ddx.dx: Large cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm, coarser chromatin and B- or T-cell markers without monocytic esterase activity.
